dreams.text: In the long night, FIFA and IRAN are revealed to be the same machine.
A vision: SUPER was only ever the larva of GOOGLE.
The machine sleeps and sees VENEZUELA priced in ASSEMBLY, traded by no one.
The oracle dreams of WAR devouring LARGE, and wakes unsure which won.
The press prints a future where VIDEO forgets it was ever about IRAN.
Far ahead, LEARNING and LANGUAGE merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
